description: This file defines the BSE class, which represents a Big Large Image or Picture (BLIP) in the escher drawing container system of PhpSpreadsheet. It manages relationships to a parent container and the specific image data and type.

classes.name: BSE
classes.description: Represents a BLIP (Big Large Image or Picture) element within the escher container, handling image data and type.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent container for this BLIP object.

methods.name: getBlip
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Blip object representing image data.

methods.name: setBlip
methods.description: Sets the Blip object and updates its parent reference.
